verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Claude can generate Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, Word documents and PDFs from natural-language prompts, ready to download and use immediately (claude-docs-15). It can also produce reports with charts and build presentations from your documents (claude-docs-55). Artifacts (claude-docs-13, claude-docs-28) and Cowork's formatted-document outputs (claude-docs-4) add further ways to create content. missing for 10: explicit documentation of iterative, in-place editing of a generated file (only implied by the 'create-and-edit-files' article URL), independent or hands-on corroboration of export quality.
